name: Kayabe Yuuna
source:
The wife of Kayabe Manzo who moved in next door.
She has a calm and gentle atmosphere, but contrary to her appearance, she is quite lustful.
Earns money on behalf of her husband at night.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc068/introduce.html#character]official website[/url]]
